pjm-cycle-queue.how: Downloaded the full PJM cycle request export on 2026-10-21 (1,792 rows, 239 in Illinois, 117 in the first cycle), saved as work/pjm/pjm_cycle_queue_2026-10-21.xlsx, and read every Illinois gas, oil and thermal request. Rechecked on 2026-10-23 for a citable page naming the four new gas requests.
pjm-cycle-queue.found: Four new gas requests filed in April 2026: C01-1569 (346 MW, Will County), C01-1570 (347 MW, Ogle County), C01-1571 (346 MW, LaSalle County) and C01-2036 (1,150 MW, Putnam County). PJM's own pages name each request but not its size or fuel. The interconnection.fyi page for each request gives the size, fuel and county, verified October 29, 2026 (staged as new plants: Will County Facility, Ogle County Hub, Prairie Pulse and Marquis Solar power stations). Nelson uprate requests are noted on the Nelson watch item.

icc-edocket.how: Ran 19 queries (plant names, owners, certificate, procurement, large load, data center, generation) through the commission's site-wide full-text search at https://www.icc.illinois.gov/search, every result page, filtered to 2022 and later, on 2026-10-23, plus one web search for generating certificate dockets. The docket, case and document search pages sit behind a reCAPTCHA; fetch.py returned the same form page and Wayback has no snapshot.
icc-edocket.found: No filing since 2022 names a gas or oil generating project, unit addition, conversion or retirement. Plant-name hits were gas pipeline safety inspections at Nelson (2022, 2023) and Lincoln Generating Facility (2022, 2025), both in GEM, plus policy material (the 2025 Resource Adequacy Study), transmission case 25-0061 and the carbon dioxide pipeline cases 22-0497 and 23-0475. The certificate case list itself needs a person to solve the reCAPTCHA once.

iepa-document-explorer.how: Ran scopes/us-il/harvest_permits.py on October 30, 2026 against the DocuWare cabinet behind the Illinois EPA Document Explorer: every final air permit, air permit application, air permit correspondence and air permit file entry filed since January 1, 2021 (14,186 documents at 4,551 sites), plus every cabinet entry under each GEM plant's site numbers and name words. 116 sites looked like power producers; 26 matched GEM plants and 96 did not. The permits and applications of 122 sites were read (248 scanned documents, text pulled by OCR) and summarized under scopes/us-il/work/permits/ (one file per GEM plant, _unmatched.md for the power-like sites GEM lacks, _applications.md). The companion data center batch reran the same harvest for its leads.
iepa-document-explorer.found: Nelson Energy Center: the 2025 construction permit 25030007 is a turbine blade and compressor uprate of the two combined cycle turbines with no capacity figure, and permit 15060042 for the two simple cycle peaking turbines was reissued in 2025 and 2026; no permit for a new combined cycle unit exists in the cabinet, so PJM request AB1-089 has no permit record. Edged Chicago LLC at 2835 Bilter Road in Aurora holds final permit 24010010 (June 18, 2024) for 64 non-emergency and 2 emergency diesel generators, 45.27 MW in all, under the 50 MW threshold; it is a watch item in the data center batch (monitor-7). Compass Datacenters ORD I in Hoffman Estates has a final construction permit 23110012 issued February 18, 2026 and revised in August 2026, for 200 generators of 2,000 kWe, five of 500 kWe and five of 800 kWe. Monarch Rock Air: a construction permit issued May 13, 2026 to Monarch Rock Air Gen LLC for the Milkweed Energy Center, twenty 12.37 MW Wartsila gas engines, 247.4 MW, in Rockford; added in the data center batch and the Illinois watch item closed. Elwood: a June 2026 letter from MPH Elwood LLC says it bought units 1 to 4 from Elwood Energy LLC on June 1, 2025, holds its own operating permit 25070017 since December 15, 2025, and shut the four units permanently on June 1, 2026; the owner of GT1 to GT4 is changed to MPH Elwood with parent Hull Street Energy, and units 5 to 9 stayed with Elwood Energy. MicroLink Stickney: no entry in the index under MicroLink; the Stickney entries are the water reclamation district's own plant and a biosolids facility, so the lead stays unverified on the watch list. Hut 8 and the Joliet Technology Center campus: no entry under either name.

us-il:new:will-county-facility-power-sta.evidence: The request connects at the Braidwood nuclear station switchyard. Will County Generating Station is a retired coal plant in Romeoville, about 45 kilometers north of Braidwood, owned by Midwest Generation, so the shared name is the county only. The other eight GEM plants in Will County are existing gas or retired coal plants 23 to 55 kilometers from Braidwood: Elwood Energy, Jackson Generation, Joliet 9, Joliet 29, Lincoln Generating Facility, Crete Energy Venture and University Park North and South. None is at the Braidwood switchyard and none is a new project.

us-il:new:marquis-solar-power-station.evidence: The only GEM plant in Putnam County is the retired Hennepin coal plant, owned by Dynegy. PJM's queue gives the request's connection as the Crescent Ridge to Corbin 138 kV line, not the Hennepin station, and the developer is Marquis Solar LLC, not the coal plant's owner. Nothing found ties the request to the Hennepin site. The request itself may be a queue entry error, which is a separate question on the record.

MISO S1040.evidence: The interconnection.fyi page for this request names it 'Surplus; J734', a 135 MW solar project at Gibson City South in McLean County. A July 2026 Renewable Energy Magazine article says Earthrise Energy's 270 MWac Archtop Solar Project (Gibson City Solar 1 and 2) started commercial operation on June 9, 2026 using MISO surplus interconnection at that peaker. Two requests of 135 MW each fit that 270 MW total. The request is solar and does not add gas capacity.

I checked the interconnection.fyi and InfraSure tracking sites, which list it only as an unnamed project of unknown location and 'Other' technology. A search for MISO 2026 cycle application lists found only a Modo Energy note that gas is 51% of all requests system-wide, with nothing request by request. No source I read names the fuel or location.

cyrusone-aurora.note: I read the final Title V permit of July 21, 2026 for CyrusOne at 2905 E. Diehl Road, Aurora. It lists 91 diesel emergency generators from 1,250 to 2,750 kW that add up to 211.25 MW.

meta-dekalb.note: I searched the Illinois EPA air notice archive (2,165 records) for Meta, Facebook and DeKalb data center permits and found none. News says the DeKalb campus is open with five buildings. No generator list, count or rating was found in any source.

t5-data-centers-grayslake.note: I searched the Illinois EPA air notice archive for a Grayslake data center permit and found none. The T5 permits in the archive are for Elk Grove Village. News describes a 1.2 GW campus planned for 2027 with grid power and says nothing about generators.

microsoft-hoffman-estates.note: The cabinet holds the CHI05 revised construction permit of March 22, 2024 (twenty 3,266 kW and one 569 kW generators, 65.9 MW) and the CHI06 and CHI07 construction permit of December 19, 2024 (thirty-two 3,100 kW and two 500 kW, 100.2 MW), 166.1 MW together.

warwick-capital-partners-decatur.note: I checked the final Illinois EPA construction permit issued October 14, 2026. It covers one turbine at 452 MW gross, the same as GEM. It is a power plant for the Archer Daniels Midland complex, not a backup fleet, so Backup Power no is right.

hut-8-hut-8-illinois-project-4-data-cent.note: The Data Center Dynamics article names a 50 MW Illinois Project 4 and no generator. I searched news and the Illinois EPA notices for gas generation and found none. It stays a watch item for no generating unit named.

powerhouse-data-centers-joliet.note: The Data Center Dynamics article describes grid substations and names no generator. I searched news and the Illinois EPA notices and found no on-site generation. It stays a watch item for no generating unit named.

monarch-rock-air-rockford.note: The Illinois EPA document library holds a construction permit issued May 13, 2026 to Monarch Rock Air Gen LLC for the Milkweed Energy Center: twenty Wärtsilä gas engines of 12.37 MW each, 247.4 MW, non-emergency, at 42.1526, -89.1186 in Rockford. Added as a primary power plant for the data center campus. The earlier nothing_found answer rested on the public notice feed alone.

cyrusone-wood-dale.note: Found by reading the Illinois EPA document library rather than the lead list. Construction permit issued May 16, 2025 for the CyrusOne CHI6 Facility at 460 and 480 Bryn Mawr Avenue, Wood Dale: 42 diesel emergency generators of 2,250 kW and two of 1,250 kW, 97.0 MW. Data Center Dynamics reported the topping out on May 21, 2025. No GEM plant exists in Wood Dale.

cyrusone-aurora-2.note: A second CyrusOne campus at 2725 Bilter Road, under construction since October 2024. An Illinois EPA construction permit of December 4, 2024, number 24080019, covers 57 diesel emergency generators for its two buildings, 127.25 MW in all, above the 50 MW threshold.

iron-mountain-des-plaines.note: The construction permit issued June 5, 2025 covers one 1,000 kW and twenty-two 3,000 to 3,213 kW diesel emergency generators, up to 71.7 MW. The company page says the site is open.

ensono-data-center-downers-grove.note: The operating permit issued July 17, 2024 covers four diesel emergency generators rated in horsepower only: two of 2,847 hp, one of 2,876 hp and one of 1,821 hp. Converted whole to electrical output that is at most 7.75 MW, far under the 50 MW threshold. The harvester's 1.25 MW figure came from a table in the permit, not the fleet.

equinix-ch-5-data-center-elk-grove-villa.note: The CH-5 operating permit issued May 21, 2026 covers fourteen 3,500 kW and one 800 kW generators, 49.8 MW; the construction permit says CH-5 and CH-3 are one source, so the plant holds both buildings, 97.3 MW.

equinix-llc-elk-grove-village.note: The CH-3 revised operating permit of April 1, 2026 covers nineteen 2,500 kW generators, 47.5 MW; it is the second unit of the Equinix Elk Grove Village plant.

stream-data-centers-elk-grove-village.note: The operating permit issued May 29, 2025 for SDC CHI I, LLC covers one 1,000 kWe, twelve 2,250 kWe and five 2,500 kWe diesel emergency generator sets, 40.5 MW. The harvester's 56 MW double counted the 2,250 kWe sets. Watch item monitor-8.

digital-grand-avenue-llc-franklin-park.note: The operating permit issued November 19, 2020 covers sixty-three diesel emergency generators from 500 to 3,000 kW, 148.75 MW, across the ORD12 to ORD14 buildings.

digital-realty-inc-franklin-park.note: The cabinet for 9401 W Grand Avenue holds Microsoft's CHI22 permits, not Digital Realty's: the revised construction permit of February 16, 2024 covers twenty-two 3,266 kW diesel emergency generators, 71.9 MW.

equinix-llc-minooka.note: The construction permit issued July 9, 2026 covers ninety-two 3.5 MW and three 1 MW diesel emergency generators, 325 MW, plus 0.65 MW of exempt engines. The harvester's 1,288 MW came from repeated table rows.

digital-northlake-llc-northlake.note: The revised operating permit of April 30, 2026 covers nine 2,000 kWe, six 2,250 kWe, four 3,000 kWe, one 420 kWe and one 450 kWe diesel emergency generator sets, 44.37 MW. The harvester's 100.62 MW double counted several groups. Watch item monitor-9.

edged-100-dekalb.note: Baird created the Edged DeKalb Project Vector plant on October 29, 2026; the staged record is in applied_in_db.json.

elk-grove-data-center-ll-elk-grove-villa.note: Baird created the Aligned Elk Grove Village plant on October 29, 2026 with 105 and 231 MW units; the staged record is in applied_in_db.json. The harvester's 5,526.5 MW is a parsing error. One update fills the blank Captive industry use box on unit 1.

compass-hoffman-estates.note: Baird created the Compass Hoffman Estates plant on October 29, 2026 with 400 and 6.25 MW units. This batch stages Backup Power yes and the captive fields on unit 1, 2.5 MW on unit 2 from the revised permit, and a new unit 3 of 4.0 MW. The harvester's 818.75 MW is a parsing error.
